name: Syrian Archer
notes: Roman auxiliary archer from Syria/Judea. Composite bow: 150/600ft range, ignores half + 3/4 cover on targets within 150ft. Rapid Fire: 2 shots per action at -2 to hit. Roman army diversity — assign to druid suppression and ogre.
gm_notes: 4-6 Syrian archers at Vindolanda garrison. They are the ANSWER to the druid problem (zone 9, normally 3/4 cover). They can fire accurately enough to force Concentration checks on the druids. Also effective vs the ogre — their range means they can engage before the ogre reaches the gate. Racially: Semitic stock, dark complexion, composite recurve bow. Excellent visual diversity for the Roman side.
